result.control_model: time-to-intercept pitch control (insights.control, from physics.pitch_control; simplified Spearman 2018): each player in view reaches a point after a 0.7 s reaction then at 5 m/s; a team's control is its softmin share of the arrival times; positions only, no ball travel time
result.danger_def: Dangerous space in view, one number for the attacking team (the team attacking the goal in view): the dangerous zone is every cell in front of that goal from which a shot is worth at least 0.05 xG (Soccermatics' logistic fit on 8,451 PL 2017/18 Wyscout shots, as in v5/v6); share = sum over the zone's cells in view of the attacking team's pitch control x that cell's xG, divided by the sum of the xG. Printed only when at least 50% of the zone (by xG weight) is in view; 2 dp, shown as a whole percent: '<Team> control 31% of the danger zone in view'

gates.scope: visible region only: control and danger use the cells the camera shows
gates.trusted: the tracking's camera fit is trusted at the frame, both teams in view, not after a goal (dead ball)

grid.encoding: base64 uint8: P(home controls) x 254 rounded; 255 = cell not in view
grid.order: row-major: byte k = j * 42 + i, j = y index from the NEAR touchline (0..26), i = x index from the left goal line (0..41); cell centre ((i + 0.5) * 2.500, (j + 0.5) * 2.519) m

result.shape_def: by depth from the team's own goal line, outfield players in view; each line = {x: mean x of its players, y_min, y_max, n, points}: back_line = the 4 deepest, drawn only when >= 85% of the strip behind the deepest (to the goal line, the penalty area's width) is in view; lines = back 4 / the rest / the 3 most advanced; width_m = touchline-to-touchline spread; depth_m = front line - back line (mean depths); line_gap_m = midfield line - back line; lines, width, depth and gap need >= 9 of 10 outfield players (shape_null_reason), the back line its own gate (back_line_null_reason); metres, 2 dp; points touchline to touchline
